Strategy: Second-best fit: score by tightest fit but subtract a large penalty from the single tightest bin whenever another bin exists, so the best-fitting bin is saved for a future item that fits only there and the item goes to the second-tightest bin. It can fail when the saved bin never receives its ideal item and the detour wastes space.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = min(bins)
    return [(-(r - item) - (500.0 if (r == m and len(bins) > 1) else 0.0)) for r in bins]
```
